instructions.name: accept_job
docs: The job's agent wallet accepts a funded job (a fiat job while Open); the agent record must be
Active. On a policy job the institution's `PreflightProof` (verifier `set_preflight_proof`,
ADR 0028) must be bound to this job, its policy snapshot and its current agent wallet (bound
again after `sync_agent_wallet`). `spec_hash` guards against a swapped spec.

accounts.name: agent
docs: Must equal `job.agent_wallet`.

accounts.name: agent_record
docs: must be Active.

accounts.name: preflight_proof
docs: job (ADR 0028): bound to this job, its policy snapshot and its current agent wallet. Not read on a
job without a policy.

instructions.name: buy_claim
docs: A screened buyer on the institution's approved list buys the receivable. `price` must equal
the listing price (front-running guard). Leaf = sha256(buyer || leaf_salt), checked against the
current `policy.buyer_root`; jobs without a policy or with an all-zero root are unrestricted.

accounts.name: policy
docs: Omitted for jobs without a policy.

instructions.name: cancel_claim
docs: The seller withdraws an unsold listing; the account is closed and its rent returned.

instructions.name: cancel_fiat_job
docs: Fiat rail (ADR 0024): the institution cancels an Open job, or an Accepted job after `deadline`.
There is no vault and nothing to refund.

instructions.name: cancel_job
docs: The institution cancels an Open / Funded job, or an Accepted job after `deadline`; the vault
balance is refunded and the vault closed (rent to `job.rent_payer`).

instructions.name: commit_travel_rule
docs: Binds a salted Travel Rule commitment to an Open job (no PII on chain, ADR 0015). It can be
replaced until `fund_job`, which requires it when `amount >= params.travel_rule_threshold`
(threshold 0 = disabled).

instructions.name: create_fiat_job
docs: Fiat rail (ADR 0024): the institution opens a job it pays off-chain through Stripe (MPP). The
job has no vault, no funding step, no challenge window, dispute or claim; it is always
proof-gated by `policy` (snapshotted like `create_job`). Both parties need a fresh, clear
screening record. The agent accepts it while Open.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent and fees; separate from the role signer (fee payer / sponsored transactions).

accounts.name: institution
docs: Institution wallet or its Squads vault; pays the agent off-chain through Stripe.

accounts.name: policy
docs: proof-gated and snapshots it.

instructions.name: create_job
docs: Flow step 3a: the institution opens a job for an active registered agent and creates its empty
vault. With the optional `policy` account the job is proof-gated and snapshots the policy's
commitment, daily ceiling and version. Funds move in `fund_job`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent and fees; separate from the role signer (fee payer / sponsored transactions).

accounts.name: institution
docs: Institution wallet or its Squads vault; funds the job and receives refunds.

accounts.name: policy
docs: job proof-gated and is snapshotted into the job.

instructions.name: escalate_missing_proof
docs: The agent's recourse when a policy job's release cannot settle: `proof_timeout_secs` after
`challenge_end` (or after a lapsed dispute closed) with no bound proof, a temporary refusal or
a proof evaluated on another UTC day, it opens a dispute without bond.

accounts.name: agent
docs: Must equal `job.agent_wallet`.

instructions.name: execute_resolution
docs: Permissionless: pays out a `Resolved` dispute. The agent-side amount goes through the same
payee resolution and proof gate as `finalize_payment` (no keeper fee); the bond is slashed to
the agent side (FavorAgent) or returned to the institution. Closes the vaults.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Permissionless caller; pays rent of the reputation/validation PDAs.

accounts.name: bond_vault
docs: Absent for an escalation without bond.

instructions.name: finalize_fiat_payment
docs: Fiat rail (ADR 0024), permissionless: records a delivered fiat job as paid once the verifier's
`verify_mpp_payment_proof` bound a compliant `ReleaseProof` (payee = agent wallet, net = full
`amount`, fresh daily counter). CPIs `record_release`, writes reputation and a `Verified`
`ValidationRecord`, moves the job to `Released`. No funds move and no keeper fee is paid.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Permissionless caller; pays rent of the reputation/validation PDAs. No keeper fee (no vault).

accounts.name: release_proof
docs: `record_release` CPI.

accounts.name: operator_state
docs: for freshness and advanced by the CPI.

instructions.name: finalize_payment
docs: Flow steps 6-8, permissionless crank. After `challenge_end` with no dispute:
- no policy: pay the payee (claim buyer if sold, else agent wallet) `amount - keeper fee`;
- policy: read `ReleaseProof` ["release_proof", job] owned by square_verifier. Missing ->
`ProofRequired` (escrow waits). `Compliant` with matching payee / net / mint / daily counter
-> pay the payee, CPI `record_release`, `ReleaseVerified`. `Refused` -> refund the net to the
institution, `ReleaseRefused` with the reason code.
The keeper fee is paid in every branch. Reputation goes to the agent record (not the buyer); a
`ValidationRecord` is written; the vault is closed and its rent returned to `job.rent_payer`.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Permissionless caller; receives the keeper fee and pays rent of the reputation/validation PDAs.

accounts.name: payee_token_account
docs: Token account of the resolved payee (claim buyer or `job.agent_wallet`).

accounts.name: institution_token_account
docs: Refund target of a refused release.

accounts.name: operator_state
docs: for freshness and written by the CPI. Policy jobs only.

instructions.name: fund_job
docs: Flow step 3b: locks `amount` in the vault. Both parties need a fresh, clear screening record.
CCTP (DRAFT M6, BC-36): runs in the same tx after the CCTP `receive_message` that mints USDC to
the institution's token account; no separate instruction is planned.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Creates the singleton config. Only the program upgrade authority (Squads vault) can call it.
`settlement_mint` is the only job mint (USDC); `linked` pins the registry / policy / verifier
program IDs used for account-read owner checks.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Must be the program upgrade authority.

instructions.name: lapse_dispute
docs: Permissionless at or after `dispute.deadline` without a decision. Returns the bond and drops
the dispute: the job goes back to `Delivered` and settles through `finalize_payment`.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless caller.

accounts.name: bond_vault
docs: Absent for an escalation without bond.

accounts.name: institution_token_account
docs: Bond refund target (the challenger of a bonded dispute is the institution).

instructions.name: list_claim
docs: The agent lists its receivable on a delivered job below face value.

accounts.name: agent
docs: Seller = `job.agent_wallet`.

instructions.name: raise_dispute
docs: The institution disputes a delivery inside the challenge window with a bond
`>= max(amount * min_bond_bps / 10_000, min_bond_absolute)`. One dispute per job.

instructions.name: resolve_dispute
docs: One arbitrator vote. The first vote sets the pending resolution, later votes must match it;
reaching the threshold moves the job to `Resolved` (`DisputeDecided`). No funds move here.

accounts.name: arbitrator
docs: One of `config.arbitrators[..arbitrator_count]`.

instructions.name: submit_work
docs: Flow step 4: delivery; the challenge window opens (`challenge_end = now + challenge_period`).

accounts.name: agent
docs: Must equal `job.agent_wallet`.

accounts.name: agent_record
docs: `accept_job` requires status Active.

instructions.name: sync_agent_wallet
docs: The agent record owner re-points an unsettled job to the record's current wallet (after a
wallet rotation with registry `update_agent`). A sold receivable keeps paying the buyer.

accounts.name: agent_owner
docs: Must equal `AgentRecord.owner`.

instructions.name: update_arbitrators
docs: Replaces the arbitrator set (N <= 7, 2 <= M <= N) and bumps `arbitrator_set_version`. An
active dispute keeps its deadline; its next vote restarts the tally with the new set.

instructions.name: update_params
docs: Updates challenge bounds, bond, keeper fee, proof and dispute timeouts and the Travel Rule
threshold.

types.name: AgentReputation
docs: seeds = ["reputation", agent_record] — bound to the registry agent, not to a wallet (BC-26).

types.name: ClaimListing
docs: seeds = ["claim", job]

fields.name: seller
docs: `job.agent_wallet` at listing time.

fields.name: buyer
docs: `Pubkey::default()` until bought.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Paid the listing rent; receives it back on `cancel_claim`.

fields.name: face_value
docs: `job.amount` at listing time (informational).

types.name: ClaimStatus
docs: `cancel_claim` closes the listing, so there is no Cancelled state.

types.name: DisputeInfo
docs: Inline dispute state; `raised_at == 0` means no dispute. One dispute per job.

fields.name: challenger
docs: Institution (`raise_dispute`) or agent wallet (`escalate_missing_proof`).

fields.name: bond
docs: 0 for an escalation without bond.

fields.name: deadline
docs: `raised_at + dispute_timeout_secs`; votes before it, `lapse_dispute` at or after it.

fields.name: decided_at
docs: When the threshold was reached.

fields.name: closed_at
docs: When `execute_resolution` or `lapse_dispute` closed the dispute.

fields.name: lapsed
docs: Set by `lapse_dispute`; the institution cannot raise a second dispute, the agent may escalate
again after `proof_timeout_secs`.

fields.name: approval_mask
docs: Bit i = `config.arbitrators[i]` voted for `resolution`.

fields.name: arbitrator_set_version
docs: `config.arbitrator_set_version` the tally is counted against; a newer set restarts the tally.

types.name: DisputeLapsed
docs: DRAFT (M5).

types.name: EscrowConfig
docs: Singleton. seeds = ["config"]

fields.name: settlement_mint
docs: The only mint jobs can use (USDC). Policy ceilings and the daily counter are in its units.

fields.name: registry_program
docs: Owner of `AgentRecord` / `ScreeningRecord` accounts read by escrow.

fields.name: policy_program
docs: Owner of `Institution` / `Policy` accounts read by escrow.

fields.name: verifier_program
docs: Owner of `ReleaseProof`; target of the `record_release` CPI.

fields.name: arbitrator_count
docs: Active slots `arbitrators[..arbitrator_count]` (N).

fields.name: threshold
docs: Approvals required (M), 2 <= M <= N.

fields.name: arbitrator_set_version
docs: Bumped on every `update_arbitrators`; disputes snapshot it.

fields.name: keeper_fee_bps
docs: Share of the escrowed amount paid to the `finalize_payment` caller (BC-23).

fields.name: proof_timeout_secs
docs: `escalate_missing_proof` allowed after `challenge_end + proof_timeout_secs` (>= 0).

fields.name: dispute_timeout_secs
docs: `dispute.deadline = raised_at + dispute_timeout_secs` (> 0).

fields.name: travel_rule_threshold
docs: Jobs at or above this amount need a Travel Rule commitment before `fund_job`; 0 = disabled.

types.name: FiatJobCreated
docs: A fiat job was opened by `create_fiat_job` (ADR 0024): no vault, always proof-gated.

types.name: Job
docs: seeds = ["job", institution, spec_hash]; vault = ["escrow_token", job], bond vault = ["bond", job]
(token authority of both = job).

fields.name: institution
docs: Institution wallet or Squads vault that created/funds the job; refund target.

fields.name: agent_record
docs: square_registry `AgentRecord` the job is bound to; reputation is written against it.

fields.name: agent_wallet
docs: `AgentRecord.wallet` at creation (or at the last `sync_agent_wallet`); signs accept/submit/list
and is the payee unless the receivable was sold.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Paid the rent of the job and its vaults; receives it back when they close.

fields.name: spec_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the off-chain job spec JSON (A2A task mapping, BE side).

fields.name: deadline
docs: Deadline for delivery.

fields.name: challenge_end
docs: Set in `submit_work`; finalize allowed after it.

fields.name: travel_rule_commitment
docs: Salted Travel Rule commitment bound before funding (ADR 0015); all zeros = none.

fields.name: policy_commitment
docs: Policy snapshot taken at `create_job` (zeros when `policy` is None). The release proof is
checked against it, so later policy updates or deactivation cannot change this job's rules.

fields.name: bond_bump
docs: Set by `raise_dispute`; 0 while no bond vault exists.

fields.name: policy
docs: square_policy `Policy`; `Some` = proof-gated release.

fields.name: rail
docs: How the job is paid (ADR 0024). Appended last: accounts created before the field read their
zero padding as `Escrow`.

types.name: MissingProofEscalated
docs: DRAFT (M5).

types.name: SettlementRail
docs: Settlement rail of a job (ADR 0024).

types.name: TravelRuleCommitted
docs: A Travel Rule commitment was bound to an Open job (BC-34).

types.name: ValidationRecord
docs: seeds = ["validation", job] — gate outcome of a settled job (BC-26); written once per job.

fields.name: refusal_code
docs: `ReleaseProof.refusal_code` when Refused, else 0.
